rows.notes: The study is a literature review (title and abstract state it is a review; sections are a literature survey summarising refs [1]-[24]). It reports no data, experiment, survey or model runs of its own. The claim passage is lifted from its Conclusions, which merely assert that automation and smart systems will make irrigation efficient and reduce water wastage, without any own evidence. The 'Results and Discussion' section only describes a cloud/IoT farm automation system from ref [24]. No primary evidence on app-based scheduling or water conservation.

notes: Conference review paper (IOP Conf. Ser. 748, 012002). Full text appears complete. Entirely secondary; no own results on any irrigation technology.
